stem_book: For 1 mol of a gas at 300 K occupying 4 L, the observed pressure is 9.5 atm. If a = 3.6 L² atm mol⁻² and b = 0.04 L mol⁻¹, find the ideal-gas pressure. (Use R = 0.0821 L atm mol⁻¹ K⁻¹). (a) 9.8 atm (b) 10.4 atm (c) 10.8 atm (d) 11.2 atm
derived: nRT/V = 6.16 atm (none); P + a/V² = 9.73 atm (≈ a only roughly)
reason: Data inconsistent: nRT/V = 6.16 atm (no option), and vdW at 300 K, 4 L gives 6.0 atm not 9.5; key a 9.8 only approximates P_obs + a/V² = 9.73 — no option is cleanly correct.
